:::{#exm-predicted-probability}
#### Predicted probability of COVID-19 after a positive test

The model of @exm-ppv gives each person tested a [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) of having COVID-19 from the test result alone.
For a person whose test is [positive](#def-positive-classification) ($\predvar = \posclass$),
that probability is the [positive predictive value](#def-ppv), the predicted probability (@def-predicted-probability) of the [class](#def-class) "has COVID-19" ($\Outvar = 1$):

$$\est{p}(\posclass) \approx 0.88$$ {#eq-predicted-probability-exm}

The [classification rule](#def-classification-rule) of @exm-classification [predicts](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) "has COVID-19" for this person,
and the predicted probability says how sure that [prediction](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) is:
about 88%, not 100%.
